Boysenberry - Banana Smoothie
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 12:33am

Ingredients




2 bananas peeled and sliced
1 1/2 cups pineapple juice
8 ounces lowfat vanilla yogurt
1 cup Boysenberries fresh or frozen

Preparation

1 Place the bananas in a single layer on a baking sheet; freeze until hard. 2 Combine the bananas, pineapple juice, yogurt and Boysenberries in the container of an electric blender; process until smooth. 3 Serve immediately.
